subject.title: fix(mattermost): backfill thread history from server when in-memory window is empty

question: Should Mattermost’s first cold thread turn synchronously wait for one bounded server-history fetch and suppress retries for the rest of that stored session after any outcome?
rationale: The approach restores context for the first response, but it intentionally trades inbound latency and transient-failure recovery behavior; tests cannot determine the preferred channel UX policy.

options.title: Accept bounded synchronous recovery
options.body: Keep one awaited, bounded fetch per stored thread session so the first recovered response has context, with no repeated load after failures.

options.title: Retry transient failures
options.body: Preserve synchronous recovery but allow a narrowly bounded retry policy for timeout or transport failures instead of marking every failed attempt complete.

options.title: Reject inbound waiting
options.body: Avoid awaited recovery on the inbound path, accepting that the first response after restart or reset may remain context-free.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded synchronous recovery
recommendation.body: Keep one awaited, bounded fetch per stored thread session so the first recovered response has context, with no repeated load after failures.
